scope: Steam Store search: broad terms errored as connection failures; descriptive/misspelled terms returned nothing.

root_cause.detail: IStoreQueryService/SearchSuggestions reports metadata.count as the full match count (live: rpg count=100 total=1483; car 100/11719; world car 65; kart 62; city builder 58) while returning at most max_results=50 items. parsePage threw IOException("Invalid store pagination") when count > SEARCH_LIMIT (50); SteamCatalogBrowser shows any exception as vapor_store_error ("Steam Store could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.").
root_cause.second: SearchSuggestions is title matching: descriptive or misspelled phrases (open world car, hollw nite, mario kart, city builder manage people) return 0 items, and its spellcheck_suggestions are not useful (oper world ca, hollo nine).

fix: Search pages report count = items returned and total = max(total, items); browse pages keep the strict check (their count drives the next offset).

Zero-result search tries up to 6 relaxed terms (contiguous word groups longest-first, then significant words longest-first, or a single word shortened by up to 3 letters; stop words skipped) and returns the first page with games, marked relaxedFrom/matchedTerm; the UI shows "No exact match for X. Showing the closest matches for Y." A fallback request failure keeps the honest empty result; cancellation propagates.

limitations: Closest-match choice is a heuristic: "mario kart" picks "mario" (Marionette titles) rather than "kart".
Results header still shows Steam total_matching_records (e.g. 1483) while search returns at most 50 items.
Emulator and live Steam only; not checked on a phone network.
